appDescription.message: Phase 4: full on-device privacy-preserving browser agent loop. Captures the visible tab, runs local WebGPU object detection (Xenova/yolos-tiny), scans the DOM for PII, redacts both the screenshot and the DOM snapshot client-side, and only then sends the redacted result to a local FastAPI server for the next action -- zero raw PII ever leaves the client.

prewarmUnknown.message: Model warm-up status unknown (no response from background).

prewarmWarming.message: ⏳ Model warming up (first run only, ~20s)—wait for this before Run Agent Loop, or step 1 will silently eat the same ~20s.

prewarmWarm.message: ✓ Model warm and ready (pre-warm took $1s). Run Agent Loop will run at full speed.

prewarmFailed.message: ✗ Pre-warm FAILED: $1. Check the background service worker console.

taskGoalPlaceholder.message: e.g. fill out the shipping address form

taskHint.message: Runs capture → detect → scan → redact → send → act on the current tab, up to 25 steps or until the agent reports done. Uses the last saved goal above, and needs the server from Settings reachable.

runStatusHint.message: A BLOCKED banner below means a guard refused an unsafe action on its own — that's the safeguard working, not something gone wrong.

failedToReachBackground.message: Failed to reach background service worker: $1

testDetectRunning.message:
Capturing current tab and running on-device detection...
(first run loads the model -- Phase 0 measured warm WebGPU inference at 8,432ms; cold load was 14,097ms. Be patient.)

runAgentLoopRunning.message: Running full agent loop on the current tab... (up to 25 steps; first detection may be slow if the model hasn't pre-warmed yet). Live progress is shown above; the page's own DevTools console has the full instrumentation.

runAgentLoopFinished.message:
Loop finished: outcome=$1, steps=$2, totalMs=$3.
Full instrumentation is in the PAGE's console (not this popup) -- look for the "RUN SUMMARY" block.

serverUrlHint.message: Server URL for the FastAPI backend (default http://localhost:8000). Must be within this extension's permitted hosts (http://localhost/*, http://127.0.0.1/*) — Chrome blocks anything else at the network layer regardless of what's typed here.

serverUrlSaved.message: Saved: $1 (background.js picks this up immediately, no reload needed).

fullPageCaptureHint.message: Full-page capture: scroll the page in steps and stitch the captures into one image before detection, instead of the visible viewport only. Default off (viewport-only remains the known-good fallback). Slower per step and uses more memory — see the RUN SUMMARY's fullPage fields for real numbers on a given page.

fullPageCaptureOn.message: On -- the next run will scroll and stitch the whole page before detection.

fullPageCaptureOff.message: Off -- the next run captures the current viewport only (default, known-good).

pipelineVersionHint.message: Pipeline: v2 (tokenized structure, semantic-first egress, local NER, real consent UI) or v1 (the original image-first loop, kept for comparison). Takes effect on the next Run agent loop click.

pipelineSetTo.message: Pipeline set to $1. Takes effect on the next Run agent loop click.

plannerBackendHint.message: Planner backend (v2 only). Local is the product default and sends nothing to the internet -- the server talks to Ollama on this machine. Claude/Gemini are an explicit opt-in for a faster live demo; either way the planner receives only tokenized structure and geometry, never a raw value. The actual server process is started with -Planner local|claude|gemini (see start-demo.ps1) -- this selector records your intent locally and is what the demo operator matches the launch flag to; the popup never sees or stores an API key, which always stays in the server's own environment variables.

plannerCloudNote.message: This sends the tokenized scene (element structure, geometry, and opaque region kinds) to a cloud API for planning speed. No personal values, no raw PII, and no image unless the planner explicitly escalates to need_visual (in which case the image sent is already redacted). Confirm you understand this before saving.

plannerCloudConfirmLabel.message: I understand -- send tokenized structure only, never raw values, to this cloud planner.

plannerConfirmRequired.message: Check the box above to confirm the opt-in before saving a cloud planner.

plannerSavedCloud.message: Saved: $1 (cloud, opt-in confirmed). Start the server with -Planner $1 to match.

plannerSavedLocal.message: Saved: local (default). Sends nothing to the internet -- the server talks to Ollama on this machine.

profileHint.message: Saved here stays on this device in this browser's local extension storage. The model never sees it and it is never sent to the server — when a page wants one of these fields, the model only ever names which category it wants (e.g. “email”), and this extension fills the value in locally. That is what lets the agent autofill a field it would otherwise have to refuse.

profileSaved.message: Saved on this device. Never sent to the server or the model.

diagnosticsHint.message: Captures the current tab and runs the on-device object detector end-to-end through background.js and the offscreen document — a developer diagnostic, not something normal use needs. First run loads the model and can take much longer than later runs.

testDetectBtn.message: Run test detection on current tab

consentEyebrow.message: Agent is asking for your approval

consentCountdownText.message: Deny is the default in $1s if you don't respond.

goalPrivacyReasonText.message: Automatic detection flagged this part of your instruction as possibly personal information. “Keep private” sends only a token in its place; “Not private” sends it exactly as you wrote it.

goalPrivacyCountdownText.message: Kept private by default in $1s if you don't respond.

outcome_blocked.message: Stopped safely -- refused an unsafe action

outcome_captureFailed.message: Failed: could not capture/detect the page

outcome_actFailed.message: Failed: could not complete the action

pending_fillProfileGeneric.message: fill '$1' with your saved profile info

policyReason_sensitiveTarget.message: This field is flagged as sensitive (for example a password, ID number, or contact field).

policyReason_irreversibleAction.message: This action may be hard to undo (for example a purchase, deletion, or account change).

policyReason_intentMismatch.message: This action doesn't clearly match what you asked the agent to do.

policyReason_serverTightened.message: The server flagged this action as needing your confirmation.

policyReason_generic.message: The agent's safety policy wants your confirmation before doing this.
